event_promote_top: Top Tier Promotion (Path of a Partner)
node_01_bg: Background: A broadcasting station office outfitted with the finest facilities. A private bar, an open view, and the dignity of a top-tier company in the industry.
node_03_pl: "When I started, I never even imagined this... and yet here I am."
node_04_bg: The office door opens, and Madam steps in, wearing an even more elegant wine-red dress.
node_06_pl: "Madam... you came all this way especially today, didn’t you?"
node_07_ld: "Of course. I wanted to congratulate you on your promotion to a first-class company in person."
node_08_ld: "Even back when I acquired this station..."
node_09_ld: "I never imagined it would come to this either."
node_10_pl: "Neither did I. Honestly... at first I thought it would fail."
node_12_bg: Madam takes a thick document envelope from within her coat and sets it on the table.
node_13_ld: "There’s nothing left for me to interfere with now."
node_15_res: "...Thank you. For believing in me and bringing me this far."
node_16_bg: Madam rises from her seat and gently pats my shoulder.
node_17_ld: "From now on, you are the face of this station."
node_18_ld: "You may dream even bigger. Overseas expansion, franchising, anything."
node_19_ld: "You are someone who can do it."
node_21_bg: Madam pauses at the doorway, then turns back.
node_23_ld: "From now on, I won’t call you ‘President’ either... I’ll call you ‘partner.’"
node_24_ld: "I look forward to working with you, partner."
node_25_pl: "Likewise, partner. I look forward to it."
node_26_bg: The office grows quiet after Madam leaves. Outside the window, the nightscape shines brightly.
